name: html-to-image-generator
description: WordPress plugin for generating images from HTML elements

scripts.build: npm run build:clean && npm run build:zip
scripts.build:zip: cd .. && zip -r html-to-image-generator.zip html-to-image/ -x 'html-to-image/.git/*' 'html-to-image/.gitignore' 'html-to-image/node_modules/*' 'html-to-image/composer.lock' 'html-to-image/.DS_Store' 'html-to-image/*.log' 'html-to-image/.env' 'html-to-image/.vscode/*' 'html-to-image/.idea/*' 'html-to-image/vendor/*' 'html-to-image/*.tmp' 'html-to-image/*.swp' 'html-to-image/*.swo' 'html-to-image/*~' 'html-to-image/.phpunit.result.cache' && echo 'WordPress.org ZIP created: html-to-image-generator.zip'
